## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (44%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability flag is on and three classes remain in the 90% set. [F6]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 44%, Benign 25%, InSitu 23% | No clear leader |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive | Three classes unresolved |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.09; OOD 94th percentile | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Invasive; 3 Normal | Neighbors contradict suggestion |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 0, 3, 5) · ↓ invasive · Benign-leaning association; scored above typical here · Unreliable (0/20)
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 9, 11) · ↑ invasive · Invasive-leaning association; scored above typical [F3] · Validated (19/20)
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 5) · ↓ invasive · Benign-leaning association; scored above typical · Validated (20/20)
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score; positive term in concept model · Weak (12/20)

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Stain, blur or out-of-distribution tissue distorts the embeddings (reliability 0.09).
- True class is Benign or InSitu; neighbors are 3 Normal, 1 InSitu, 1 Benign.

## Check on the slide
1. **9, 11** — Confirm tumor infiltrating stroma, not reactive stroma.
2. **10** — Are atypical cells duct-confined? This separates InSitu from Invasive.
3. **0, 3, 5** — Normal-lobule score failed spot check; confirm benign architecture directly.
